title: agentkernel.execution/v0.2 shared definitions
description: Types shared by the execution request, result and event contracts. Mirrors agentkernel/api. Referenced by relative URI from the sibling schemas.

version.description: api.ExecutionVersion. Any other value is refused.

sha256_digest.description: api.ValidDigest: canonical content digest, as produced by api.Digest.

timestamp.description: RFC 3339 time, as encoded by Go time.Time.

trust.description: api.Trust. Only host content may become a system instruction.

artifact_ref.description: api.ArtifactRef: identifies stored bytes exactly. The digest pattern and size minimum are contract rules; ExecutionRequest.Validate does not check a context item's ref.

nullable_count.description: A token count; null is unknown, never zero.

token_usage.description: api.TokenUsage. Every count is present; null means unknown. input counts every input token; cached_input (cache reads) and cache_write_input (cache writes) are the parts of input billed at their own rates.
